claims.value: A text-generation model from the Pythia family, specifically a corrected weight-seed 2 variant trained from an independent seed-2 weight initialization. It was trained for 143,000 steps on the Pile dataset with a global batch size of 1,024 sequences.
claims.evidence: This model was trained from an independent seed-2 weight initialization while keeping the original Pythia training-data order fixed.
The model was trained for 143,000 steps on the Pile with a global batch size of 1,024 sequences and a context length of 2,048 tokens.
